steps.caption: Import toe-clamps.dxf: six closed loops on three named layers.
Open the complete toe-clamp recipe to inspect stock, tools and operations.
Stock is 76 x 70 x 8 mm, centred in XY with its top at Z0.
G54 zero is the top front-left stock corner: X-38 Y-35 Z0.
Pocket only the two TOE_RECESS loops with the 3 mm end mill.
The pocket bottom is 2 mm below stock top.
Drill only the two SCREW_HOLE circles with the 3 mm drill.
Profile the outlines with four triangular tabs per clamp.
Regenerate all three toolpaths. This practice profile is 5 mm deep, not a through-cut.
Simulate the whole setup; inspect the recesses and material beneath the profiles.
Post all operations to one UCCNC program in millimetres.
Export the G-code after reviewing the preview and diagnostics.
Open the fixture plate: one setup, five operations and four tools.
Check the 125 x 90 x 8 mm stock and the G54 top front-left zero.
T2: 6 mm end mill. T3: 5 mm drill. T4: thread mill. T6: chamfer mill.
Face 1 removes 0.5 mm. Face and Contour share T2.
Drill fourteen holes; the two locating-pin seats stay unthreaded.
Thread Mill selects only the twelve M6 x 1 pilot holes.
Keep the shipped order: Face, Drill, Thread Mill, Contour, Chamfer.
Simulate the complete setup and inspect the face, holes, threads and chamfers.
Choose UCCNC, All operations and Combined (one file).
One program: T2, T3, T4, T6. Later tool changes use M6 and an M0 pause.
On a configured machine, follow the guided M6 card. This clip performs no machine motion.
Open the tool-storage bar: two sides of one 160 x 50 x 12 mm stock.
Top - G54 uses the top front-left stock corner.
New Setup: Second side of Top - G54, Turned about Y. Cancel: the recipe already has both sides.
The saved bottom setup uses G55. Imported bottom.svg supplies the mirrored hole positions.
Regenerate both setups. Each side drills, bores and chamfers its own three holes.
Simulate Top - G54 separately; simulation covers the active setup.
Now simulate Bottom - flip about Y - G55. Simulation does not animate a physical flip.
Combine all operations in UCCNC and enable Pause between setups (M0).
Review G54, the spindle stop and M0, then G55. Export the combined program.
At the real pause: turn 180 deg about Y, secure the part and establish physical G55 zero.
